cases.question: 2017 年 GMV 是多少？按月和各州排名的趋势怎样？

intents.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(`total_gmv`) AS `gmv_2017` FROM `mv_monthly_sales` WHERE `sales_month` LIKE '2017-%'

cases.question: 平台整体准时交付率是多少？哪些州延迟最严重？

intents.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `order_delivered_customer_date` <= `order_estimated_delivery_date` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS `overall_on_time_rate` FROM `orders` WHERE `order_status` = 'delivered' AND `order_delivered_customer_date` IS NOT NULL AND `order_estimated_delivery_date` IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.`customer_state` FROM (SELECT c.`customer_state`, COUNT(*) AS `total_delivered_orders`, SUM(CASE WHEN o.`order_delivered_customer_date` > o.`order_estimated_delivery_date` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `delayed_orders`, SUM(CASE WHEN o.`order_delivered_customer_date` > o.`order_estimated_delivery_date` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS `delay_rate` FROM `orders` o INNER JOIN `customers` c ON o.`customer_id` = c.`customer_id` WHERE o.`order_status` = 'delivered' AND o.`order_delivered_customer_date` IS NOT NULL AND o.`order_estimated_delivery_date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.`customer_state` HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20) s ORDER BY s.`delay_rate` DESC, s.`delayed_orders` DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 产品的重量、尺寸与运费之间有什么关系？

intents.gold_sql: WITH `item_features` AS (SELECT `oi`.`freight_value`, `p`.`product_weight_g`, (`p`.`product_length_cm` * `p`.`product_height_cm` * `p`.`product_width_cm`) AS `product_volume_cm3` FROM `order_items` `oi` INNER JOIN `products` `p` ON `oi`.`product_id` = `p`.`product_id` WHERE `oi`.`freight_value` IS NOT NULL AND `p`.`product_weight_g` IS NOT NULL AND `p`.`product_length_cm` IS NOT NULL AND `p`.`product_height_cm` IS NOT NULL AND `p`.`product_width_cm` IS NOT NULL) SELECT (COUNT(*) * SUM(`product_weight_g` * `freight_value`) - SUM(`product_weight_g`) * SUM(`freight_value`)) / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(`product_weight_g` * `product_weight_g`) - POW(SUM(`product_weight_g`), 2)) * (COUNT(*) * SUM(`freight_value` * `freight_value`) - POW(SUM(`freight_value`), 2))), 0) AS `corr_weight_freight`, (COUNT(*) * SUM(`product_volume_cm3` * `freight_value`) - SUM(`product_volume_cm3`) * SUM(`freight_value`)) / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(`product_volume_cm3` * `product_volume_cm3`) - POW(SUM(`product_volume_cm3`), 2)) * (COUNT(*) * SUM(`freight_value` * `freight_value`) - POW(SUM(`freight_value`), 2))), 0) AS `corr_volume_freight` FROM `item_features`

SELECT CASE WHEN `p`.`product_weight_g` < 500 THEN '0-499g' WHEN `p`.`product_weight_g` < 1000 THEN '500-999g' WHEN `p`.`product_weight_g` < 2000 THEN '1000-1999g' WHEN `p`.`product_weight_g` < 5000 THEN '2000-4999g' ELSE '5000g+' END AS `weight_bucket`, AVG(`oi`.`freight_value`) AS `avg_freight_value` FROM `order_items` `oi` INNER JOIN `products` `p` ON `oi`.`product_id` = `p`.`product_id` GROUP BY `weight_bucket`

SELECT COALESCE(`pct`.`product_category_name_english`, `p`.`product_category_name`) AS `product_category` FROM `order_reviews` `r` INNER JOIN `orders` `o` ON `r`.`order_id` = `o`.`order_id` INNER JOIN `order_items` `oi` ON `o`.`order_id` = `oi`.`order_id` INNER JOIN `products` `p` ON `oi`.`product_id` = `p`.`product_id` LEFT JOIN `product_category_name_translation` `pct` ON `p`.`product_category_name` = `pct`.`product_category_name` WHERE `r`.`review_score` <= 2 GROUP BY `product_category` ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 2017年哪个州的销售额最高？交付准时率是多少？哪种支付方式最受欢迎？

intents.gold_sql: SELECT `customer_state` AS `top_state_2017` FROM `mv_state_sales` WHERE `sales_month` LIKE '2017-%' GROUP BY `customer_state` ORDER BY SUM(`total_gmv`) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH `top_state` AS (SELECT `customer_state` FROM `mv_state_sales` WHERE `sales_month` LIKE '2017-%' GROUP BY `customer_state` ORDER BY SUM(`total_gmv`) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `o`.`order_delivered_customer_date` <= `o`.`order_estimated_delivery_date` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS `on_time_rate_2017` FROM `orders` `o` INNER JOIN `customers` `c` ON `o`.`customer_id` = `c`.`customer_id` INNER JOIN `top_state` `ts` ON `c`.`customer_state` = `ts`.`customer_state` WHERE `o`.`order_status` = 'delivered' AND `o`.`order_purchase_timestamp` >= '2017-01-01' AND `o`.`order_purchase_timestamp` < '2018-01-01' AND `o`.`order_delivered_customer_date` IS NOT NULL AND `o`.`order_estimated_delivery_date` IS NOT NULL

WITH `top_state` AS (SELECT `customer_state` FROM `mv_state_sales` WHERE `sales_month` LIKE '2017-%' GROUP BY `customer_state` ORDER BY SUM(`total_gmv`) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT `p`.`payment_type` AS `most_popular_payment_type` FROM `orders` `o` INNER JOIN `customers` `c` ON `o`.`customer_id` = `c`.`customer_id` INNER JOIN `payments` `p` ON `o`.`order_id` = `p`.`order_id` INNER JOIN `top_state` `ts` ON `c`.`customer_state` = `ts`.`customer_state` WHERE `o`.`order_purchase_timestamp` >= '2017-01-01' AND `o`.`order_purchase_timestamp` < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY `p`.`payment_type` ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT `o`.`order_id`) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 哪些卖家的差评率最高？

intents.gold_sql: SELECT `oi`.`seller_id` FROM `orders` `o` INNER JOIN `order_items` `oi` ON `o`.`order_id` = `oi`.`order_id` LEFT JOIN `order_reviews` `r` ON `o`.`order_id` = `r`.`order_id` GROUP BY `oi`.`seller_id` HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `r`.`review_score` IS NOT NULL THEN `o`.`order_id` END) >= 20 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `r`.`review_score` <= 2 THEN `o`.`order_id` END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `r`.`review_score` IS NOT NULL THEN `o`.`order_id` END), 0) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `r`.`review_score` IS NOT NULL THEN `o`.`order_id` END) DESC LIMIT 20
